blocks.text: Mode woh qeemat (ya qeematein) hai jo data mein sab se zyada baar aati hai. Biology mein is se kisi sample ki sab se aam khasiyat (trait) samajh aati hai, jaise kisi paude par phoolon ki sab se aam tadaad, kisi population mein beejon ka sab se aam size, ya janwaron ke sample mein sab se zyada aane wala wazan.
